# Fixtures

* `private/` is a git-ignored symlink to real screenshots of the owner's PC (`/home/claude/fixtures_private`).
  They are used for tests only; never commit them.
* `synth/` - synthetic screens generated by `tools/gen_fixtures.py` (committed; small PNGs).
* `ground_truth/<fixture>.json` - hand-written truth, format in `docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`.
* `bench_out/<fixture>.result.json` - recorded real OCR+translation output from the Windows bench, so most
  logic can be replayed offline in the sandbox (commit these; they contain only recognised text of synthetic screens).
